# cache/loinc/

This material contains content from LOINC® (http://loinc.org). LOINC is
copyright © 1995-2025, Regenstrief Institute, Inc. and the Logical Observation
Identifiers Names and Codes (LOINC) Committee and is available at no cost under
the license at http://loinc.org/terms-of-use.

- `terms.csv` holds the LOINC codes bound in `kb/` with their Long Common Names,
  written by the term validator against the Monarch KG. Never hand-edit it; see
  CLAUDE.md, "LOINC Codes".
- `external_copyright_codes.csv` and `external_copyright_notices.csv` hold
  LOINC's EXTERNAL_COPYRIGHT_NOTICE field, normalised: every LOINC code that
  carries a third-party notice, mapped to a notice id, and one row per distinct
  notice. They are generated by `just loinc-copyright-notices` from the source
  pinned in `data/loinc/MANIFEST.yaml`. Never hand-edit them.
